item.title: 规模销售
item.summary: 规模化 SMB 销售不是把人海销售搬到线上，而是用产品自助获客分流意图、市场完成标准交易、伙伴承接集成与本地信任、客户成功按风险触发介入。公开证据支持这种分层，但没有玩家披露可比的 CAC、留存和完全成本贡献。

synthesis.outlook_12_36m: 竞争将从伙伴数量和市场列表转向意图路由、标准交易自动化、伙伴服务质量与异常客户成功的同 cohort 经营闭环。
synthesis.strategic_summary: 规模化 SMB 销售不是把人海销售搬到线上，而是用产品自助获客分流意图、市场完成标准交易、伙伴承接集成与本地信任、客户成功按风险触发介入。公开证据支持这种分层，但没有玩家披露可比的 CAC、留存和完全成本贡献。
synthesis.why_now: SME 云采用仍显著落后于大企业，同时云市场、间接 CSP、伙伴利润和 AI 自动化已形成可拼接的低触达基础设施。
winner_conditions: positive fully loaded contribution after incentive and support
fast escalation for payment, access and outage risks
partner economics that survive price competition

evidence.source_quote: Grow with us and make up to a 25% margin when you join the DigitalOcean Partner Pod
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Explicit partner-margin offer provides a channel-economics anchor for an SMB-focused cloud archetype.

evidence.source_quote: Revenue was $281.7 billion, up 15 percent. Operating income grew 17 percent to $128.5 billion. And Azure surpassed $75 billion in revenue for the first time, up 34 percent.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Financial scale anchor for a vendor that can fund direct, partner and digital coverage; it does not disclose SMB CAC or channel profitability.

evidence.source_quote: This year, AWS SMB Competency Partners grew their SMB AWS business 35% more YoY as compared to a similar group of Partners without SMB Competency.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Vendor-reported comparison supports specialization plus lead-passing as an SMB scale motion; cohort construction is not independently audited.

evidence.source_quote: They not only helped give us more transparency into our costs and how to keep them as low as possible, they also had more strategic advice for some of the newer products from Google Cloud.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Named production case demonstrates partner-provided billing transparency and advisory support for an SME serving 60,000 businesses.

evidence.source_quote: By working with experienced indirect providers, you can go to market without having to make a large investment.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Defines the two-tier distributor/reseller mechanism that transfers billing, support and managed-service reach to partners.

evidence.source_quote: many MSPs argued that licensing margins are now so thin, and competition from larger CSPs so aggressive, that the incentive to stay in the licensing game at all is questionable
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Trade-media counterevidence that channel breadth can degrade into price competition and weak partner economics.

evidence.source_quote: Cloud marketplaces fail to do demand gen
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Dated community opinion separates procurement/logistics utility from demand generation and human selling; it is not a company fact.

evidence.source_quote: We’ve seen that customers who purchase in AWS Marketplace are 40% more likely to come back and buy additional products
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Named partner production case connects marketplace procurement to repeat purchase, multi-year contracts and cash collection.

evidence.source_quote: account locked out suddenly without any follow-up to my inquiries from customer service over 48+ hours
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Dated community incident signal that automated low-touch coverage can create severe support tail risk; it is not a representative reliability statistic.

evidence.source_quote: 60-70% improvement in operational efficiency by automating product approval
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Named SMB-platform production outcome shows why repeatable packaged use cases matter; vendor attribution and baseline are not audited here.

evidence.source_quote: Our million+ dollar customer ARR was $133 million, growing 123% year-over-year.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Counterevidence to a pure SMB-volume thesis: a historically SMB-oriented cloud is highlighting rapid concentration in million-dollar customers.

evidence.source_quote: software vendors reported their AWS Marketplace business grew 41 percent faster than their overall software business
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Commissioned IDC result is a reported estimate for marketplace/co-sell leverage, not an independent causal estimate or SMB-only cohort.

evidence.source_quote: dedicated 70% of our total incentive spend to partners that serve the Small, Medium Enterprises and Channel (SME&C) segment
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Directly identifies partner incentives as Microsoft's priority coverage mechanism for the SME&C segment.

evidence.source_quote: In 2025, 85% of large businesses bought cloud services, while only 52% of SMEs did so.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Independent adoption-gap baseline: product availability and partner reach have not eliminated the SMB cloud adoption gap.

evidence.source_quote: Customers can negotiate a statement of work and buy professional services via customized private offers either directly from the service provider or through a chosen reseller
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Shows Google digitizing discovery, contracting, reseller choice, consolidated billing and partner service delivery.

evidence.source_quote: The fact that Go Autonomous was hosted on Google Cloud, an infrastructure we already trust and use ourselves, made the choice even easier
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Named production case proves marketplace discovery can connect a buyer to a partner solution for a manual ordering gap.

evidence.source_quote: We’re a small company, and we monitor our costs very closely.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Named SMB case supports simplicity and cost as entry criteria while retaining a selective AWS service, limiting single-cloud lock-in claims.
